english.title: Driver of goods vehicle fail to produce international road transport permit for inspection / copy
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), without reasonable excuse, failed to produce an international road transport permit that was carried on the vehicle, to an examiner, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) and allow that examiner to inspect and copy it, when required to do so by the examiner under section 6(2)(a) of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(2) and (6) of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018.

english.notes: For the purposes of this offence, an examiner means an examiner appointed under section 66A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 or Article 74 of the Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 1995.
